description: This file defines functions for configuring Vitest test extension providers, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration for extension providers.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables, falling back to null if not set.

methods.name: export function createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig( createExtensionProvidersVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration specific to extension providers, loading include patterns and setting configuration options.
